title: Ennamma Kannu
desc: Kaasi, a womaniser, tries to woo Gayatri, a young woman, but she thwarts his advances. However, when her fiancé deserts her on the day of her wedding, Kaasi offers her refuge.

title: Thadayam
desc: A graduate struggles to find any jobs and thus resorts to going to prison for earning a living. However, things get complicated when a criminal lawyer falls for him, but he loves someone else.

title: Maya
desc: Kalingarayan, a man with evil powers, wants to gain his youth back and has to kill a child with some special characteristics.

title: Manithanin Marupakkam
desc: Sujatha, a journalist, covers the story of Ravi who has been sentenced for murdering his wife Kala, Sujatha's sister. However, a day before his scheduled execution, Ravi escapes the prison.

title: Punnagai Desam
desc: Three friends leave their homes when their parents refuse to support their dreams. Later, when they meet a friend in Chennai, they begin to pursue their ambitions.

title: Oru Naal Oru Kanavu
desc: Maya, a college student, always wants to triumph in all her endeavours. Later, after arguing with Cheenu, a happy-go-lucky youngster, she challenges him that she will make him fall in love with her.

title: Kanna
desc: A school trip sparks unexpected feelings in Annapoorani, a student, who forms a deep admiration for a tour guide. Later, overcome with emotion, she flees from home on a scooter to meet him.

title: Kanmani Unakaga
desc: A son is anguished to see his mother go to prison after being sexually assaulted. However, he is not aware of the true story behind this turn of events.

title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

title: Thoondil
desc: Anjali and Sriram live a happily married life. However, things take a turn when Divya kidnaps their only child to seek revenge against Sriram.
